post_1.html.title: Porsche Panamera 4S V8 AWD/PPF/Exhaust
post_1.html.body:
Excellent-condition 2011 Porsche Panamera 4S finished in Dark Blue Metallic with a Black/Platinum Grey leather interior. Powered by a naturally aspirated 5.0L V8 and equipped with Porsche's PDK transmission and all-wheel drive.

I am the 2nd owner and this car has been very well maintained - a great combination of luxury, performance, and everyday comfort.

Features:

Approximately 90,000 miles

5.0L V8

AWD (4S)

PDK Automatic Transmission

Premium Package Plus

BOSE Premium Audio

Adaptive Sport Seats with Memory

Heated Front & Rear Seats

Adaptive Air Suspension

ParkAssist with Backup Camera

Power Sunroof

Power Sunblinds

20" Porsche 911 Turbo II Wheels

Performance-Tuned Aftermarket Exhaust

Paint Protection Film (PPF)

Professionally Tinted Windows

Clean Title

2nd Owner

Originally over $120,000 MSRP, this Panamera still delivers the performance and refinement Porsche is known for. The aftermarket exhaust gives the V8 an incredible sound, while the PPF and window tint help keep the car looking great.

Selling because I recently purchased a Porsche Taycan.

Serious inquiries only. No trades. Contact me with any questions or to schedule a time to see it.
